patterns: APPSC asks drainage as one-fact identification: 'X dam/project is on which river' (Srisailam, Somasila, Polavaram, Nagarjuna Sagar, Basava Sagar), 'river rises where' (Penna - Nandi hills), 'meets sea in which district' (Penna - Nellore), 'Gandikota on which river'.

Recurring numbers: Godavari 1,465 km; 40 rivers / inter-state count; Tungabhadra forms 58 km AP-Karnataka boundary; Godavari 2 distributaries at Dowleswaram; Penna 536 km in AP. Wording decides the key ('longest' was keyed Godavari in 2025 and Penna in 2022).

Project-purpose questions: Polavaram = National Project (Sec 90), Pattiseema = lift irrigation linking Godavari-Krishna (Limca record A-R), Telugu Ganga = Chennai/Tamil Nadu, KRMB allocates Srisailam water, NW-4 = Krishna waterway.
Match-the-pair on river-origin hills (Vamsadhara-Jayapur, Machkund-Mudugal, Gundlakamma-Nallamala, Pennar-Nandidurga) appeared in 2025; the app covers this well.

The app is broadly accurate but floods the topic with micro-detail (tank parks, mandals, tributary confluence villages, 2026 inauguration dates, flood warning levels) and long 4-5 statement sets; APPSC rarely goes below river-project-district level.
